items.title: Five equivalent formulations of regularity for a morphism of schemes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records five equivalent formulations of the regularity of a morphism: the morphism itself, flatness with geometrically regular fibres, the ring-map condition on every compatible pair of affine opens, the same condition on an open cover, and the condition on an affine open cover. The proof reconciles the global formulations with the ring-theoretic one by localising and using that regularity is checked on affine opens, so the content is the assembly of the local conditions into the global ones. Retained author proof at lines 5701-5733.
